scope: Reusable same-rig action library and eight-direction alpha sprite exports; no live gameplay replacement
higherTierPolicy: Reuse the same deform hierarchy and normalized timings; scale root travel and attachments with model scale. Horns/armor attach to named bones, fire/smoke remain separate VFX. Higher-tier artwork is not part of this export.

research.principle: Wing forelimbs can participate in terrestrial support and propulsion; use distinct fore/hind support phases rather than quadruped hindleg copies.
Flight uses a broad extended downstroke and a more retracted upstroke; wing joints must articulate rather than rotating a flat wing rigidly.
